Class AnnotationValue

java.lang.Object
be.imgn.inject.context.AnnotationValue
public final class AnnotationValue extends Object
One annotation captured at compile time: its type, its member values, and the framework stereotypes it carries.

Values are held as data rather than as an annotation instance, so reading them needs neither reflection nor a generated implementation class. Member values are value-based: primitives (boxed), String, Class, enum constants, or Lists of these for array-valued members.

A stereotype is a meta-annotation on the annotation type — here always one of InjectingAnnotation, QualifyingAnnotation, or ScopingAnnotation.
